patthana22.12:2.1: arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato na arūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā pañca, na kusalaṃ na pariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na kusalaṃ na pariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na abyākataṃ na pariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā pañca, na kusalaṃ na apariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo apariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. abyākato apariyāpanno dhammo-. dve, (akusalamule dve, duka mūle dve, hetuyā cha.) na kusalaṃ na niyyānikaṃ
